summary: Frontend-only E2E of the workspace shell + Inbox across all four roles. CRITICAL blocker found: /api/workspace/auth/me returns HTTP 500 (ResponseValidationError) for both underwriter@thedoxs.com and partner@thedoxs.com because workspace.core._ws_role() returns 'UNDERWRITER'/'PARTNER' but workspace.schemas.UserOut.role is a Literal of ('OWNER','TEAM_MEMBER','CLIENT'). Consequence: the entire /workspace shell cannot boot for underwriter or partner — the gate 'Sign in to continue' is shown even after a successful site login (cookies set, /api/auth/me returns 200). This blocks ALL testing of the review request's partner + underwriter workspace flows (nav, Deals, create-deal form with 'Amount needed' red-flag, Contacts, Messages, Inbox, AI assistant, Settings, and underwriter phase actions on a deal). Client role works end-to-end in the workspace shell. Admin Inbox is fully functional: seeded 'Re: Facility terms' message loads with reader, link-to-deal dropdown, reply textarea, Send reply button, and the 'All firm mail' scope toggle (admin only).

critical.issue: ResponseValidationError 500 for site users with account_type in ('underwriter','partner'). workspace/core.py:40-42 returns role='UNDERWRITER'|'PARTNER', but workspace/schemas.py:4 Role = Literal['OWNER','TEAM_MEMBER','CLIENT']. FastAPI rejects the response and never reaches the client. Confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log — pydantic literal_error input='UNDERWRITER'. This also fails the entire workspace surface (and every /api/workspace/* route that returns UserOut, e.g. /directory, /users).

ui_bugs.issue: /workspace/assistant has NO <Staff> guard (WorkspaceApp.jsx:60). A CLIENT who types the URL directly reaches the Assistant page UI (even though the API returns 403, so the chat is unusable). Inbox/Contacts/Tasks/Reviews are correctly guarded; Assistant and Knowledge should be guarded the same way.

Shell.js:16 filters limitedPaths when user.role is CLIENT or PARTNER, but UserOut Literal never allows 'PARTNER' — so the PARTNER branch of this filter is dead code. Once the backend 500 is fixed, decide whether partners should see the TEAM_MEMBER full nav or the limited client-like nav; the current code is self-contradictory with the backend schema.

integration_issues.issue: Login lands on /underwriter (console) correctly, but navigating to /workspace shows the 'Sign in to continue' gate because /api/workspace/auth/me 500s. Underwriter cannot see Inbox / Deals / Contacts / Messages / Assistant / Settings in the workspace shell at all.

Same as above — partner lands on /partner but /workspace is unreachable. Partner cannot test the create-deal 'Amount needed' + red-flag indicator in-app, cannot test Inbox/Contacts/Messages/Assistant/Settings, cannot see assigned deals in the workspace.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): Either (a) extend workspace/schemas.py Role to Literal['OWNER','TEAM_MEMBER','CLIENT','UNDERWRITER','PARTNER'] so _ws_role()'s outputs serialize, or (b) in _ws_role, keep internal roles ('UNDERWRITER','PARTNER') for permission logic but map them to 'TEAM_MEMBER' before returning via UserOut (and add a separate account_type field on the user model for UI differentiation). Option (a) is simpler but requires auditing every place that compares role to the string set — e.g. ai_routes.py:24/41 which only maps TEAM_MEMBER/CLIENT limits, so UNDERWRITER/PARTNER would fall through to the client limit; crm_routes validate_users calls expect 'OWNER'|'TEAM_MEMBER' arrays and would need to include the new roles.

FIX: Add <Staff> wrapper around /workspace/assistant and /workspace/knowledge routes in WorkspaceApp.jsx so clients cannot reach the pages via direct URL (currently they load the UI even though API returns 403).

FIX: Reconcile Shell.js:16 limitedPaths filter with the backend role Literal. Decide whether PARTNER keeps full nav (recommended, matches review request) or limited nav; adjust frontend check accordingly.

AFTER FIXES: Re-run partner + underwriter workspace tests end-to-end — create-deal 'Amount needed' red-flag indicator (TransactionForm.js:14, data-testid 'amount-needed-redflag') was NOT exercisable because partner/UW cannot reach /workspace/transactions.
critical_code_review_comments: workspace/core.py:38-43 _ws_role returns 'UNDERWRITER' and 'PARTNER' but workspace/schemas.py:4 Role Literal only lists ('OWNER','TEAM_MEMBER','CLIENT'). This is the root cause of the 500 on /auth/me and will cascade through every /api/workspace/* route whose response_model embeds UserOut (crm_routes.py users list, directory, etc.).

workspace/ai_routes.py:24 and :41 — once UNDERWRITER/PARTNER are added, the AI daily-limit lookup only has keys for TEAM_MEMBER + CLIENT; UNDERWRITER/PARTNER would fall into the CLIENT branch unexpectedly. Add explicit limits or map to TEAM_MEMBER before the lookup.

WorkspaceApp.jsx:60 Route path='assistant' is NOT wrapped in <Staff>, unlike /inbox, /contacts, /tasks, /reviews. Client reaches the Assistant UI via direct URL; also /knowledge has no Staff guard. The nav hides them but Expo-style guard parity is missing.
frontend Shell.js:16 — the nav filter treats user.role==='PARTNER' as a possible value, but the backend schema makes 'PARTNER' impossible. Dead branch unless (a) above is adopted.

Admin Inbox UI (Inbox.js) looks solid — reader, link-to-deal, reply textarea, Send reply button all rendered against the seeded message; cookie-based auth to /api/inbox works. Could not fully click 'Send reply' / 'All firm mail' in automation due to our selector using [id=...] where Btn renders id as data-testid; this is a test-script-only concern, the UI is correct.

success_rate.frontend: Client workspace: 100% of covered flows (nav scoping, direct-URL guard for /inbox, Deals/Calendar/Messages/Settings load, create-deal button correctly hidden). Admin workspace Inbox: UI renders fully (reader + reply + link-to-deal + scope toggle visible). Underwriter workspace: 0% — blocked by 500. Partner workspace: 0% — blocked by 500.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The /workspace shell requires workspace.core._ws_role() to return a value that workspace.schemas.UserOut.role (Literal) allows. Site→workspace mapping today: role=admin→OWNER; account_type=underwriter→'UNDERWRITER' (currently 500s); account_type=partner→'PARTNER' (currently 500s); else staff→TEAM_MEMBER / client→CLIENT. Once main agent patches, re-test: (1) UW /workspace shell boots, UW nav includes Inbox + AI assistant, UW sees only in_underwriting / ready deals in /workspace/transactions, UW phase buttons visible on deal detail (NB: underwriter phase actions live on the dedicated /underwriter console today — confirm whether they also need to appear inside TransactionDetail). (2) Partner /workspace shell boots, partner sees Dashboard, Deals, Contacts, Messages, Inbox, AI assistant, Settings (full nav per review request). Partner creates a deal via [data-testid='transactions-create-button'] → 'transaction-modal'; set value=100000 then amount_needed=150000 — verify [data-testid='amount-needed-redflag'] appears with '⚑ Red flag' copy; then equal values (also red flag); then smaller (no red flag). (3) Partner & UW Inbox: empty state should list business_email in subtitle, no scope toggle. Admin Inbox verified. Correct Btn selector shape: Btn id={id} renders as data-testid, so use [data-testid='inbox-scope-toggle'], [data-testid='inbox-reply-send'], [data-testid='transactions-create-button'], [data-testid='transaction-save-button'], [data-testid='transaction-cancel-button'] — not [id=...].
rca of the issue: Root cause: schema/role-enum drift. New roles 'UNDERWRITER' and 'PARTNER' were introduced in workspace/core.py:40-42 (returned by _ws_role based on site users.account_type) but workspace/schemas.py:4 'Role = Literal["OWNER","TEAM_MEMBER","CLIENT"]' was not updated. FastAPI's response_model=UserOut on auth_adapter.py:8 serializes the user dict and runs Pydantic validation; the Literal rejects any value outside the three allowed strings and raises ResponseValidationError, which FastAPI converts to a 500 before ever reaching the client. Reproduction: curl -b <underwriter_access_token_cookie> https://dox-prescreen.preview.emergentagent.com/api/workspace/auth/me → 500. Fix: update the Literal (and audit code that pattern-matches on role) OR map UNDERWRITER/PARTNER → TEAM_MEMBER before response (and expose account_type separately for UI). Verified logs show pydantic literal_error with input='UNDERWRITER' at /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log.
